steps.title: Install Happy Hare and create official base files
steps.summary: Use the Happy Hare interactive installer for MMU type, gate count, controller, selector-touch choice, LEDs, servo, clog detection, EndlessSpool, and printer.cfg includes.

steps.title: Import the generated user-editable files
steps.summary: Load mmu.cfg, mmu_hardware.cfg, mmu_parameters.cfg, and mmu_macro_vars.cfg so GKCC can preserve every existing value and comment on missing essentials.

steps.title: Verify motors, servo, encoder, and sensors
steps.summary: Confirm pin assignments and live states before automatic movement.

steps.title: Calibrate selector positions
steps.summary: Calibrate all selector gates, then verify individual gate alignment before loading filament.

steps.title: Calibrate gear rotation distance
steps.summary: Use a measured filament length and save only after the physical result repeats.

steps.title: Calibrate and validate the encoder
steps.summary: Use a long move and repeated passes; compare load and unload counts and test over the intended speed range.

steps.title: Clean the nozzle with a guided cold pull
steps.summary: Follow the material-specific macro and leave the toolhead empty for clean geometry calibration.

steps.title: Calibrate clean toolhead dimensions
steps.summary: Measure entry sensor to gears, gears to internal nozzle shoulder, and toolhead sensor to internal nozzle shoulder. Lock any moving filament buffer during geometry measurement.

steps.title: Calibrate Bowden length
steps.summary: Use gate 0 and the best available extruder homing point; compare repeated non-saving runs before saving.

steps.title: Optionally calibrate individual gates
steps.summary: Calibrate gate-specific movement only after gate 0 gear, encoder, toolhead, and Bowden values are correct.

steps.title: Controlled load and unload verification
steps.summary: Heat appropriately, observe sensors and encoder, inspect cutter/tip formation, and record commanded versus measured movement.

steps.title: Set FlowGuard and long-print features
steps.summary: Apply the measured clog-detection recommendation, verify EndlessSpool mappings, and test backup gates before long prints.

steps.title: Run representative tool-change endurance tests
steps.summary: Increase from a few swaps to a long repeat test while tracking failures by gate and stage.
